name: freecam-workflow-builder
description: Browser editor for a freeCAM step: order, processes, parameters, kernels; generates freeCAM Python.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/build-codegen.mjs
scripts.build:pages: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build --base=/freeCAM/ --outDir dist-pages && node scripts/build-codegen.mjs
